ApplyAutoSnapshotPolicy.title: ApplyAutoSnapshotPolicy
ApplyAutoSnapshotPolicy.summary: Apply an automatic snapshot policy to cloud computers. After the automatic snapshot policy is applied to the cloud computers, Elastic Desktop Service automatically creates snapshots for the cloud computers based on the time specified in the automatic snapshot policy.
ApplyAutoSnapshotPolicy.description:
You can also associate an automatic snapshot policy with a cloud desktop in the Elastic Desktop Service (EDS) console. To do so, perform the following steps: 1. Log on to the EDS console. 2. Choose Desktops and Groups > Desktops in the left-side navigation pane. 3. Find the cloud desktop that you want to manage on the Cloud Desktops page and choose More > Change Automatic Snapshot Policy in the Actions column. 4. Configure a policy for the cloud desktop as prompted in the Change Automatic Snapshot Policy panel.

After you associate an automatic snapshot policy with the cloud desktop, the system creates snapshots for the cloud desktop based on the policy.

CreateADConnectorOfficeSite.title: CreateADConnectorOfficeSite
CreateADConnectorOfficeSite.summary: Creates an enterprise Active Directory (AD) office network (formerly workspace). Elastic Desktop Service supports the following types of accounts: convenience accounts and enterprise AD accounts.
CreateADConnectorOfficeSite.description:
When you create an enterprise AD office network, the system automatically creates an AD connector to connect to an enterprise AD. You are charged for the AD connector. For more information, see [Billing overview](~~188395~~).

After you call this operation to create an AD office network, you must perform the following steps to complete AD domain setting:

1.  Configure a conditional forwarder in a Domain Name System (DNS) server.

2.  Configure a trust relationship in an AD domain controller and call the [ConfigADConnectorTrust](~~311258~~) operation to configure the trust relationship with the AD office network.

3.  Call the [ListUserAdOrganizationUnits](~~311259~~) operation to query a list of organizational units (OUs) of the AD domain, and call the [ConfigADConnectorUser](~~311262~~) operation to specify an OU and administrator for the AD office network.

    >  When you create the AD office network, take note of the DomainUserName and DomainPassword parameters. If you specify the parameters, you need to only configure a conditional forwarder. If you do not specify the parameters, you must configure a conditional forwarder, trust relationship, and OU as prompted.

For more information, see [Create and manage enterprise AD office networks](~~214469~~).

CreateDesktops.title: Create one or more cloud desktops
CreateDesktops.description:
Before you create a cloud computer, complete the following preparations:

- Create an office network (formerly known as a workspace) and users. For more information, see the following API operations and documents:

  - Simple office network: [CreateSimpleOfficeSite](~~215416~~) and [CreateUsers](~~437832~~).

  - Active Directory (AD) office network: [CreateADConnectorOfficeSite](~~215417~~) and [Create an AD user](~~188619~~).

- Call the [CreateBundle](~~188883~~) operation to create a cloud computer template, or use an existing one.

- Call the [CreatePolicyGroup](~~188889~~) operation to create a policy, or use an existing one.

To have the cloud computer automatically run a custom command script, use the `UserCommands` parameter to configure the custom command.

- Each standard workspace can create one NAS file system to meet the need for sharing files between cloud desktops in the workspace.

KeepDuration.description:
The duration to keep a session after disconnection. Unit: milliseconds. Valid values: 180000 (3 minutes) to 345600000 (4 days). A value of 0 indicates that the session is always kept.

If a session disconnects, either actively by the user or due to other factors, the system calculates the retention period from the disconnection time. If the user does not re-establish a connection to the session within this period, the session logs off, and all unsaved data is destroyed. If the user successfully re-establishes a connection within this period, they can resume the original session and access data from before the disconnection.

When session utilization reaches this threshold, new WUYING Workspaces are created. When it falls below this threshold, excess WUYING Workspaces are deleted.

The execution status of the command. The value of this parameter is determined by the execution states of the command on all participating cloud computers.

Valid values:

*   Finished: The command execution completes on all cloud computers. Alternatively, the command execution is manually stopped on some cloud computers while it completes on the others.
*   Stopped: The command execution stops.
*   Failed: The command execution failed on all cloud computers.
*   Running: Once there is a command execution in progress, the execution status defaults to Running.
*   PartialFailed: If the command execution failed on part of the cloud computers, the execution status is considered partially failed.

The response parameters.

NextToken.description: The query token that is returned from this call.

InvocationStatus.description:
The overall execution status of the command. The value of this parameter depends on the execution status of the command on all the involved cloud computers. Valid values:

*   Pending: The command is being verified or sent. If the execution status is Pending on at least one cloud computer, the overall status is considered Pending.

*   Running: The command is being executed on cloud computers. If the execution status is Running on at least one cloud computer, the overall status is considered Running.

*   Success: If the execution status is Success on at least one cloud computer and either Success or Stopped on all other cloud computers, the overall status is considered Success.

*   Failed: If the execution status is Stopped or Failed on all cloud computers, the overall status is considered Failed. If any execution status on cloud computers matches one of the following values, Failed is returned.

    *   Invalid: The command is invalid.
    *   Aborted: The command failed to be sent.
    *   Failed: The command is executed, but the exit code is not 0.
    *   Timeout: The command execution timed out.
    *   Error: An error occurred when the command is being executed.

*   Stopping: The command execution is being stopped. If the execution status is Stopping on at least one cloud computer, the overall status is considered Stopping.

*   Stopped: The command execution stops. If the execution status is Stopped on at least one cloud computer, the overall status is considered Stopped. If any execution status on cloud computers matches one of the following values, Stopped is returned.

    *   Cancelled: The command execution is canceled.
    *   Terminated: The command execution is terminated.

*   PartialFailed: The command execution succeeded on some cloud computers but failed on others. If the execution status on any cloud computer is Success, Failed, or Stopped, the overall status is considered PartialFailed.

> The VPC connection depends on Alibaba Cloud PrivateLink. You can use Alibaba Cloud PrivateLink for free. When you set this parameter to `VPC` or `Any`, PrivateLink is automatically activated.

enumValueTitles.INTERNET: (default) Cloud computers are connected from Alibaba Cloud Workspace clients over the Internet.
enumValueTitles.VPC: Cloud computers are connected from Alibaba Cloud Workspace clients over the VPC.
enumValueTitles.ANY: Cloud computers are connected from Alibaba Cloud Workspace clients over the Internet or the VPC. When end users connect to cloud computers from Alibaba Cloud Workspace clients, you can choose a connection method based on your business requirements.

SsoEnabled.description: Indicates whether single sign-on (SSO) is enabled.

CidrBlock.description: The IPv4 CIDR block of the VPC that the office network uses.

Bandwidth.description:
The maximum public bandwidth value. Valid values: 0 to 1000.
If you leave this parameter empty or set this parameter to 0, Internet access is not enabled.

Name.description: The name of the office network. The name is unique in a region.

EnableInternetAccess.description: Indicates whether Internet access is enabled.

DomainPassword.description: The password of the domain administrator.

CustomSecurityGroupId.description: The ID of the security group.

OuName.description: The organizational unit (OU) in the AD domain to which the office network is connected.

DomainUserName.description: The username of the domain administrator.

SubDomainName.description: The username of enterprise AD subdomain.

OfficeSiteId.description: The IDs of the office networks.

MfaEnabled.description: Indicates whether multi-factor authentication (MFA) is enabled.

DnsUserName.description: The username of a Domain Name System (DNS) user.

OfficeSiteType.description: The account type of the office network.

ConnectorStatus.description: The status of the AD connector.

enumValueTitles.CONNECTING: You must configure the AD domain in which the AD connector is used.

VSwitchId.description: The ID of the vSwitch that resides in the network of the AD connector.

ADConnectorAddress.description: The connection address of the AD connector.

TrustKey.description: The trust password that is specified when you configure the AD trust relationship.

NetworkInterfaceId.description: The ID of an elastic network interface (ENI) to which the AD connector is mounted.

Step.description: The step in the log entry.

Message.description: Details of the log entry.

TimeStamp.description: The time when the log entry was printed.

FileSystemIds.description: An array of File Storage NAS (NAS) file system IDs.

SubDnsAddress.description: The DNS addresses for the AD subdomains.

items.description: The DNS address for the AD subdomain.

DnsAddress.description: The DNS addresses for the AD domains.

items.description: The DNS address for the AD domain.

NeedVerifyLoginRisk.description: Indicates whether two-factor verification is enabled when an end user logs on to an Alibaba Cloud Workspace client. This parameter is required only for convenience office networks. If two-factor verification is enabled, the system checks whether security risks exist within the logon account when a convenience user logs on to the client. If risks are detected, the system sends a verification code to the email address that is associated with the account. Then, the convenience user can log on to the client only after the user enters the correct verification code.

DesktopCount.description: The number of cloud computers that are created.

TotalEdsCount.description: The total number of cloud computers.

TotalEdsCountForGroup.description: The number of cloud computers in the cloud computer share.

NeedVerifyZeroDevice.description: Indicates whether the trusted device verification is enabled.

CloudBoxOfficeSite.description: Indicates whether the CloudBox-based office network is created.

AdHostname.description: The hostname of the domain controller. The hostname must comply with the hostname naming convention of Windows.

RdsLicenseStatus.description: The remote desktop service (RDS) license status.

RdsLicenseAddress.description: The IP address of the RDS license.

RdsLicenseDomainName.description: The domain name of the RDS license.

BackupDns.description: The DNS address of the secondary domain controller.

BackupDCHostname.description: The hostname of the secondary domain controller.

EnableServiceRoute.description: Indicates whether route access control is enabled for cloud services.

SubnetMode.description: The subnet mode of the office network.

SecurityProtection.description: The security protection setting of the office network.

enumValueTitles.OFF: No security protection setting is configured.

CustomAccessPoint.description: The custom endpoint of the access gateway.

TotalResourceAmount.description: The number of network interface controllers (NICs).

NmVersion.description: The network version. The new version supports App Streaming.

AcceleratorId.description: The ID of the GA instance.

DomainName.description: The domain name of the enterprise AD.

DescribePolicyGroups.description: The details of the cloud computer policies.

items.description: The details of the cloud computer policy.

PolicyStatus.description: The status of the cloud computer policy.

Html5Access.description: Specifies whether to allow web client access.

enumValueTitles.DesktopIp: The IP address of the cloud computer.
enumValueTitles.ClientIp: The IP address of the Alibaba Cloud Workspace client.
enumValueTitles.HostName: The rightmost 15 digits of the cloud computer ID.
enumValueTitles.ClientTime: the current time displayed on the cloud computer.

PreemptLogin.description:
The cloud computer preemption feature.

> To ensure user experience and data security, when a cloud computer is used by an end user, other end users cannot connect to the cloud computer. By default, this parameter is set to `off`, which cannot be modified.

WatermarkCustomText.description: If you set `WatermarkType` to `custom`, you must also specify `WatermarkCustomText`.

enumValueTitles.read: Specifies one-way transfer. You can copy files only from local devices to cloud computers.
enumValueTitles.readwrite: Specifies two-way transfer. You can copy files between local devices and cloud computers.
enumValueTitles.write: Specifies one-way transfer. You can only copy files from cloud computers to local devices.
enumValueTitles.off: Disables both one-way and two-way transfer. Files cannot be copied between local devices and cloud computers.

PolicyGroupId.description: The ID of the cloud computer policy.

PrinterRedirection.description: Indicates whether the printer redirection feature is enabled.

Html5FileTransfer.description: The file transfer feature on the web client.

enumValueTitles.all: Files can be uploaded and downloaded between local computers and the web client.
enumValueTitles.download: Files on the web client can be downloaded to local computers.
enumValueTitles.upload: Files on local computers can be uploaded to the web client.
enumValueTitles.off: (Default) Files cannot be transferred between the web client and local computers.

UsbRedirect.description: Indicates whether the USB redirection feature is enabled.

PolicyGroupType.description: The type of the cloud computer policy.

EdsCount.description: The number of cloud computers that are associated with the policy. The number of cloud computers that are associated only with custom policies is returned.

Name.description: The name of the cloud computer policy.

LocalDrive.description: The permissions on local disk mapping.

enumValueTitles.read: Read-only. Local disk mapping is available on cloud computers. However, you can only read (copy) local files but cannot modify the files.
enumValueTitles.readwrite: read and write. Local disk mapping is available on cloud computers. You can read (copy) and write (modify) local files.

Type.description: The direction of the security group rule.

Policy.description: The authorization of the security group rule.

Description.description: The description of the security group rule.

PortRange.description: The port range of the security group rule.

IpProtocol.description: The protocol type of the security group rule.

enumValueTitles.icmp: Internet Control Message Protocol (ICMP) for IPv4

Priority.description: The priority of the security group rule. A smaller value indicates a higher priority.

CidrIp.description: The object to which the security group rule applies. The value is an IPv4 CIDR block.

AuthorizeAccessPolicyRules.description: The client IP address whitelist. End users can access cloud computers only from the IP addresses in the whitelist.

items.description: The client IP address in the whitelist.

Description.description: The remarks on the CIDR block that is allowed to access the client.

CidrIp.description: The CIDR block that is allowed to access the client. The value is an IPv4 CIDR block.

ClientTypes.description: The logon method control rules to limit the type of the Alibaba Cloud Workspace client used by end users to connect to cloud computers.

Status.description: Indicates whether end users are allowed to use a specific type of the client to connect to cloud computers.

PreemptLoginUsers.description: The usernames that can preempt to connect to the cloud computer.

items.description: The username that can preempt to connect to the cloud computer.

GpuAcceleration.description: Indicates whether the Image Quality Control feature is enabled. If you have high requirements on the performance and user experience in scenarios such as professional design, we recommend that you enable this feature.

VendorId.description: The vendor ID (VID). For more information, see [Valid USB VIDs](https://www.usb.org/sites/default/files/vendor_ids032322.pdf_1.pdf).

Description.description: The rule description.

UsbRedirectType.description: Indicates whether USB redirection is allowed.

DeviceClass.description: The device class. This parameter is required when `usbRuleType` is set to 1. For more information, see [Defined Class Codes](https://www.usb.org/defined-class-codes).

DeviceSubclass.description: The subclass of the device. This parameter is required when `usbRuleType` is set to 1. For more information, see [Defined Class Codes](https://www.usb.org/defined-class-codes).

UsbRuleType.description: The type of the USB redirection rule.

DomainResolveRuleType.description: Indicates whether the switch for domain name resolution is turned on.

items.description: The details of the domain name resolution rule.

Policy.description: Indicates whether the domain name resolution rule is allowed.

Description.description: The rule description.

NetRedirectRule.description:
The network redirection rule.

> This parameter is in invitational preview for specific users and not available to the public.

items.description:
The details of the network redirection rule.

> This parameter is in invitational preview for specific users and not available to the public.

Policy.description: Indicates whether the rule is allowed.

Recording.description: Indicates whether the screen recording feature is enabled.

enumValueTitles.byaction_cmd_ft: Enables the operation-triggered screen recording upon command execution and file transfer.
enumValueTitles.ALLTIME: Enables the whole-process screen recording. That is, the recording starts when cloud computers are connected and ends when the cloud computers are disconnected.
enumValueTitles.PERIOD: Enables the interval-based screen recording. You must specify an interval between the start time and end time of this type of recording.
enumValueTitles.byaction_commands: Enables the operation-triggered screen recording upon command execution.
enumValueTitles.byaction_file_transfer: Enables the operation-triggered screen recording upon file transfer.

RecordingStartTime.description: The time when the screen recording was started. The value is in the HH:MM:SS format. The value takes effect only when Recording is set to PERIOD.

RecordingEndTime.description: The time when the screen recording ended. The value is in the HH:MM:SS format. The value takes effect only when Recording is set to PERIOD.

RecordingFps.description: The frame rate of screen recording. Unit: fps.

RecordingExpires.description: The retention period of the screen recording file. Valid values: 1 to 180. Unit: days.

CameraRedirect.description: Indicates whether the webcam redirection feature is enabled.

NetRedirect.description:
Indicates whether the network redirection feature is enabled.

> This parameter is in invitational preview for specific users and not available to the public.

AppContentProtection.description: Indicates whether the anti-screenshot feature is enabled.

RecordContent.description: Indicates whether the custom screen recording feature is enabled.

RecordContentExpires.description: The period when the custom screen recording can be retained before expiration. Default value: 30 days.

RemoteCoordinate.description: The permissions on keyboard and mouse control during remote assistance.

enumValueTitles.optionalControl: By default, you are not granted the permissions. You can apply for the permissions.
enumValueTitles.fullControl: You are granted the full permissions.
enumValueTitles.disableControl: You are not granted the permissions.

RecordingDuration.description: The file length of the screen recording. Unit: minutes. Screen recording files are split based on the specified file length and uploaded to Object Storage Service (OSS) buckets. When a screen recording file reaches 300 MB in size, the system preferentially performs rolling update for the file.

Scope.description: The effective scope of the policy.

enumValueTitles.IP: The policy takes effect based on the IP address.

ScopeValue.description: This parameter is required when the `Scope` parameter is set to `IP`.\`\`\`\`

items.description: The effective scope specified by a CIDR block.

RecordingAudio.description: Indicates whether audio files generated from cloud computers are recorded.

VideoRedirect.description: Indicates whether the multimedia redirection feature is enabled.

WatermarkTransparencyValue.description: The watermark transparency. A greater value indicates that the watermark is less transparent. Valid values: 10 to 100.

WatermarkColor.description: The font color in red, green, and blue (RGB) of the watermark. Valid values: 0 to 16777215.

WatermarkFontSize.description: The font size of the watermark. Valid values: 10 to 20.

WatermarkDegree.description: The slope of the watermark. Valid values: -10 to -30.

WatermarkRowAmount.description:
The number of watermark rows.

> This parameter is not available for public use.

EndUserApplyAdminCoordinate.description: Indicates whether the Contact Administrator for Help switch is turned on.

EndUserGroupCoordinate.description: Indicates whether the User Stream Collaboration switch is turned on.

CpuProtectedMode.description: Indicates whether the CPU spike protection switch is turned on.

CpuRateLimit.description: The overall CPU usage. Valid values: 70 to 90. Unit: percentage (%).

CpuSampleDuration.description: The overall CPU sampling duration. Valid values: 10 to 60. Unit: seconds.

CpuSingleRateLimit.description: The single-CPU usage. Valid values: 70 to 100. Unit: %.

CpuDownGradeDuration.description: The CPU underclocking duration. Valid values: 30 to 120. Unit: seconds.

CpuProcessors.description: The process whitelist that is not restricted by the CPU usage limit.

MemoryProtectedMode.description: Indicates whether the memory spike protection switch is turned on.

MemoryRateLimit.description: The overall memory usage. Valid values: 70 to 90. Unit: %.

MemorySampleDuration.description: The overall memory sampling duration. Valid values: 30 to 60. Unit: seconds.

MemorySingleRateLimit.description: The memory usage of a single process. Valid values: 30 to 60. Unit: %.

MemoryDownGradeDuration.description: The memory underclocking duration for a single process. Valid values: 30 to 120. Unit: seconds.

MemoryProcessors.description: The whitelist of processes that are not restricted by the memory usage limit.

WatermarkSecurity.description: Indicates whether the security priority feature is enabled for invisible watermarks.

WatermarkAntiCam.description: Indicates whether the anti-screen photo feature is enabled for invisible watermarks.

RecordingUserNotify.description: Indicates whether the screen recording notification feature is enabled after end users log on to the Alibaba Cloud Workspace client.

RecordingUserNotifyMessage.description: The notification content of screen recording. By default, this parameter is left empty.
RecordingUserNotifyMessage.example: 您的云电脑正在被录屏

AdminAccess.description:
Indicates whether end users are granted the administrator permissions.

> This parameter is in invitational preview for specific users and not available to the public.

MaxReconnectTime.description: The maximum retry period for reconnecting to cloud computers when the cloud computers are disconnected due to none-human reasons. Valid values: 30 to 7200. Unit: seconds.

DisplayMode.description:
The display mode.

Valid values:

- clientCustom:

- adminOffice: suitable for daily office scenarios.

- adminDesign:

- adminCustom: administrator-customized scenarios

enumValueTitles.intelligent: Suitable for daily office scenarios (Intelligent Mode).
enumValueTitles.smooth: Suitable for design and 3D application scenarios (Smooth Mode).

ColorEnhancement.description: Indicates whether the Color Enhancement switch is turned on in design and 3D scenarios.

SmoothEnhancement.description: Indicates whether the Smooth Enhancement switch is turned on.

QualityEnhancement.description: Indicates whether the Image Quality Enhancement switch is turned on for design and 3D scenarios.

enumValueTitles.qualityFirst: The priority given to the image quality.
enumValueTitles.bandwidthFirst: The priority given to the bitrate.

TargetFps.description: The destination frame rate. Valid values: 10 to 60. Unit: fps.

VideoEncMinQP.description: The minimum quantizer parameter (QP) of video files. A smaller QP value indicates higher video quality. Valid values: 0 to 51.

VideoEncMaxQP.description: The maximum quantizer parameter (QP) of video files. A larger QP value indicates worse video quality. Valid values: 0 to 51.

VideoEncAvgKbps.description: The average bitrate for video encoding. Valid values: 1000 to 50000.

VideoEncPeakKbps.description: The peak bitrate for video encoding. Valid values: 1000 to 50000.

RedirectType.description:
The redirection type. Valid values:

- usbRedirect

- deviceRedirect

- off: direction disabled.

DeviceVid.description: The vendor ID (VID). For more information, see [Valid USB VIDs](https://www.usb.org/sites/default/files/vendor_ids032322.pdf_1.pdf).

WyAssistant.description:
Specifies whether to provide the AI Assistant function in the DesktopAssistant when the cloud computer is accessed from the Alibaba Cloud Workspace desktop clients (including the Windows client and the macOS client).

> Desktop clients of V7.7 and higher versions required.

enumValueTitles.off: The AI Aisstant function is not provided.
enumValueTitles.on: The AI Aisstant function is provided.

ResourceRegionId.description:
The region of the cloud computer policy.

> The value of a region-less policy is `center`.

DomainList.description: Specifies whether to enable the access control for domain names. Domain names support wildcards (\*). Separate multiple domain names with commas (,).

StatusMonitor.description: Specifies whether to provide the Metrics function in the DesktopAssistant.

MobileRestart.description:
Specifies whether to display the restart button in the DesktopAssistant when the cloud computer is accessed from the Alibaba Cloud Workspace mobile clients (including the Android client and the iOS client).

> Mobile clients of V7.4 and higher versions required.

MobileShutdown.description:
Specifies whether to display the shut down button in the DesktopAssistant when the cloud computer is accessed from the Alibaba Cloud Workspace mobile clients (including the Android client and the iOS client).

> Mobile clients of V7.4 and higher versions required.

DesktopCount.description: The number of cloud computers bound with this policy.

DesktopGroupCount.description: The number of shared cloud computers bound with this policy.

ResourceGroupCount.description: The number of resource groups bound with this policy.

RecordEventFilePaths.description: The array of absolute paths of the monitored files in the screen recording audit policy.

items.description: The absolute path of the monitored file in the screen recording audit policy.

RecordEventRegisters.description: The array of absolute paths of the monitored registry entries in the screen recording audit policy.

items.description: The absolute path of the monitored registry entry in the screen recording audit policy.

RecordEventDuration.description: The recording duration since a target event is detected by the screen recording audit policy. Unit: Minute. Valid values: 10-60.

AutoReconnect.description: The automatic client connection recovery configurations.

MobileWuyingKeeper.description: Indicates whether the Cloud Computer Manager is enabled for mobile clients.

MobileSafeMenu.description: Indicates whether the Windows security control is enabled for mobile clients.

MobileWyAssistant.description: Indicates whether the Xiaoying AI Assistant is enabled for mobile clients.

RecordEventLevels.description: Indicates whether the screen recording event severity is enabled.

ModifyCloudDrivePermission.title: Modify user permissions for file transfer between enterprise file storage and on-premises devices
ModifyCloudDrivePermission.description:
When accessing the file storage within WUYING Workspace, file uploads and downloads between them are always allowed because both reside in a secure environment. However, if the visibility of the file storage on WUYING Terminal has been enabled, end users can directly access the file storage through the WUYING Terminal interface.

To prevent end users from transferring sensitive data from WUYING Workspace to on-premises devices via the file storage, the default policy allows users to upload files from on-premises devices to the enterprise file storage but prohibits downloading files from the enterprise file storage to on-premises devices. This default policy applies to all users of the file storage, and you do not need to configure its scope.

If needed, you can invoke this API to control user permissions for file transfer between the enterprise file storage and on-premises devices. Users added here will be exempt from the default policy.

ModifyDesktopSpec.title: ModifyDesktopSpec
ModifyDesktopSpec.description:
Changing a WUYING Workspace configuration involves either modifying its specification or scaling up its disks.

- Before changing the configuration, check the supported specifications and disk sizes for WUYING Workspace. For more information, see [WUYING Workspace specifications](~~188609~~). Call [DescribeDesktopTypes](~~DescribeDesktopTypes~~) to query supported specifications.

- Change at least one of the following: the WUYING Workspace specification, system disk size, or data disk size. Specify at least one of these parameters: `DesktopType`, `RootDiskSizeGib`, or `UserDiskSizeGib`. Note the following:

  - A WUYING Workspace specification includes vCPU, memory, and GPU settings. Change only from one full specification to another. Do not change individual components.

  - Do not switch between general office and non-general office specifications. Do not switch between graphics and non-graphics specifications.

  - Scale up both the system disk and the data disk. Do not scale them down.

  - If you purchased the WUYING Workspace on a monthly basis, the system calculates the price difference based on the old and new configurations. Pay the difference or receive a refund.

  - For the same WUYING Workspace, wait at least 5 minutes between two configuration changes.

  - Stop the WUYING Workspace (Stopped).

- Your personal data stored on the WUYING Workspace remains unchanged after the configuration change.

ModifyImagePermission.description:
### [](#)Security of shared images

Elastic Desktop Service cannot guarantee the integrity and security of shared images. When you use a shared image, you must make sure that the image comes from a trusted sharer or account, and you are legally responsible for using the shared image.

### [](#)Quota and billing

*   A shared image does not count against the image quotas of principals to which the image is shared.
*   After a principal uses a shared image to create a cloud computer, the sharer is not charged for the shared image.
*   You are not charged for shared images.

### [](#)Supported sharing behaviors

*   You can share custom images with other Alibaba Cloud accounts.
*   You can share custom images between accounts in the China site (aliyun.com) and the international site (alibabacloud.com).

### [](#)Unsupported sharing behaviors

*   You cannot share images that are shared by other Alibaba Cloud accounts.
*   You cannot share encrypted images.
*   You cannot share images across regions. If you want to share an image across regions, you must copy the image to the destination region and then share the image. For more information, see [CopyImage](~~436978~~).

RebuildDesktops.title: RebuildDesktops
RebuildDesktops.summary: You can change the image for one or more cloud desktops.
RebuildDesktops.description:
Image changes are subject to the following restrictions:

- You cannot change a desktop in China (Hong Kong) or outside China to an image with a different operating system, such as from a Windows image to a Linux image.

- You cannot switch between GPU and non-GPU images. Graphics-enabled desktops can use only GPU images, and non-graphics desktops can use only non-GPU images.

After you change the image, the system reinitializes the desktop’s system disk using the new image. This affects your data as follows:

- All data on the original system disk is deleted. Snapshots created from the original system disk become unusable and are automatically removed.

- If you change to an image with a different operating system, all data on the original data disk is deleted. Snapshots created from the original data disk become unusable and are automatically removed. If the operating system remains the same, the original data disk and its snapshots are retained.
RebuildDesktops.responseParamsDescription:
- If the status code is `200`, the `RebuildResults` list shows whether each desktop started rebuilding. A `Code` value of `Success` means the desktop started rebuilding. Any other value is an error code indicating why the rebuild failed.

- If the status code is `4xx`, the parameters were invalid, and no desktops started rebuilding.

RatioThreshold.description:
The threshold for the ratio of connected sessions. This parameter is the condition that triggers auto scaling in a multi-session cloud computer pool. Formula:

`Ratio of connected sessions = Number of connected sessions/(Total number of cloud computers × Maximum number of sessions allowed for each cloud computer) × 100%`.

When the specified threshold is reached, new cloud computers are automatically created. When the specified threshold is not reached, idle cloud computers are released.

KeepDuration.description:
The keep-alive duration of a session after the session is disconnected. Unit: milliseconds. Valid values: 180000 (3 minutes) to 345600000 (4 days). A value of 0 indicates that the session always keeps alive.

If a session is disconnected by the end user or accidentally due to a factor and the end user does not re-establish a connection with the session within the keep-alive duration, the session expires and unsaved data is deleted. If the end user successfully re-establishes a connection with the session within the keep-alive duration, the end user returns to the session and can still access the original data.
